title: Longitudinal Upper-Arm Stroking
summary: The palm glides over the upper arm from the elbow toward the shoulder.
goal: Prepare the upper-arm muscles for later work.
startingPosition: The arm is relaxed and supported.
instructions: Glide upward over the muscular upper arm.
Do not press on the joint.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, inflammation, or impaired sensation.
